posts.name: Spiff
posts.cooked:
Here's another conversation starter (bored at work today):  what do we want to see from the next Kickstarter when it comes around?  Obviously (or is it...?) we all want at least one more alternate hero, since that seems to be the norm with each expansion.  Personally, I don't find the art prints to be compelling, or getting my face on a card, but I found the whole new hero and villain decks (with or without having to pay $5, I'm fine with either) to be very, very compelling.  And I found the alternate villains to be quite compelling as well.  Things like the oversized villain cards are probably a huge deal to some people, but since I play with my own oversized accessories, those aren't quite as squee-worthy for me.

So I'd want to see new brand heroes, villains, and environments available as rewards first, as many as humanly possible.  After that comes alternate versions of existing heroes and villains, followed by pretty much everything else.  What about you guys?

I like playing with dice and I went to a chessex dealer at PAXEast immediately after buying the game and bought about a dozen matching pairs of dice to use with the game. The Greater Than Games guys actually gave me hero and villain HP trackers that I've never used because the dice are so convenient. Friends of mine use a pen and paper for every target or they use pennies for trash targets and pen and paper for heroes and villains. 

 

Of course I would like to see more content stuff as rewards, Alt hero and villain cards, new decks of every variety. Or even just cool stuff like deck boxes much like the ones that Spiff made, which I use and are always commented on as "the best idea ever".

posts.name: Blossercubbles
posts.cooked:
One would guess that the Visionary would play lead in the Time & Space expansion (much like Legacy was lead in the core game, Wraith in Rook City, and...more of a communal Ra/Nightmist lead with Infernal Relics) thus potentially bringing a promo card for her.

 

As for what to hope for with new KickStarts, well...I'd like the oversized villain cards to keep happening. I had no idea that I would like them as much as I do, and I don't even have my game yet! Any extra decks and play materials are always excellent, and I enjoy seeing the art prints around the house.

 

I must say that the 'Get Your Face on a Card' thing is a great option, I find many of the cards that feature these people are easy to distinguish from the more comic-like extra characters, and in some cases it can be a bit jarring. GloomWeaver has some that really seem to fit, and I don't recall noticing anything with Rook City, so maybe it's just that there are simply more of them that I'm noticing.

 

Anyway, if it came down to no bonuses whatsoever, I would still have a smile just seeing more of the Multiverse fleshed out with physical cards.
